name: Pinecone
label: Pinecone — indexes and vectors (REST 2026-04)
description: Official Pinecone REST 2026-04. Control plane https://api.pinecone.io (index.list/create/delete). Data-plane vector.* use https://{host} (index host from describe_index). Auth: Api-Key from secret api_key. Every request sends X-Pinecone-Api-Version: 2026-04. Docs: https://docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/introduction.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put api_key here. Example: {"operation":"index.list"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: index.list | index.create | index.delete | vector.upsert | vector.query | vector.fetch | vector.delete | vector.update. trigger.listen is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP. Do not put api_key here. Example: 'index.list'.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Index name for index.create and index.delete. Path {name} on delete.

schema.label: host
schema.description: Index data-plane host for vector.* (from describe_index.host, no scheme). Example: my-index-abc.svc.aped-4627-b74a.pinecone.io. Required on vector ops when config host is empty.

schema.label: dimension
schema.description: Dense vector dimension for index.create. Official CreateIndexRequest: required when vector_type is dense (default); omit for sparse. Range 1–20000. Docs: https://docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/2026-04/control-plane/create_index

schema.label: metric
schema.description: Similarity metric for index.create. EXACT: cosine | euclidean | dotproduct. Dense defaults to cosine. Sparse requires dotproduct.

schema.label: spec
schema.description: Official spec object. Required. Exactly one of serverless.{cloud,region}, pod, or byoc. Docs: https://docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/2026-04/control-plane/create_index

schema.label: vector_type
schema.description: index.create vector_type. EXACT: dense | sparse. Default dense. Sparse: omit dimension; metric must be dotproduct.

schema.label: vectors
schema.description: vector.upsert records: {id, values, metadata?}[]. Official max 1000 records or 2 MB per request. Do not log values. Docs: https://docs.pinecone.io/reference/api/database-limits

schema.label: vector
schema.description: Query embedding number[] for vector.query (or use id).

schema.label: id
schema.description: Existing vector id for query-by-id or vector.update.

schema.label: ids
schema.description: vector.fetch query param. Official API repeats ids=; OfficialApiNode sends one ids= value — pass a comma-separated list.

schema.label: setMetadata
schema.description: Metadata fields to set on vector.update.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: index.list | index.create | index.delete | vector.upsert | vector.query | vector.fetch | vector.delete | vector.update.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: Pinecone project API key. Sent as header Api-Key. StudioQuack secret. Never on INPUT. Console: https://app.pinecone.io/

configurationParameters.label: Index host
configurationParameters.description: Default Pinecone index host for vector.* (describe_index.host). INPUT host wins. Example: my-index-abc.svc.aped-4627-b74a.pinecone.io.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
